questions.q: Which dbatools cmdlet checks free disk space on drives visible to a SQL Server instance?
options: Get-DbaDisk
Test-DbaVolume
Test-DbaDiskSpace
Check-DbaFreeSpace
questions.explain: Test-DbaDiskSpace follows the Verb-DbaNoun convention (Test- validates something) and reports free space per drive.

options: A count of active connections
The last known-good DBCC CHECKDB date per database
A list of every table in a database
The database's current recovery model
questions.explain: It surfaces integrity-check recency, one of the core signals in a daily DBA health check.

questions.q: What is the main automation value of building a [PSCustomObject] from several health-check cmdlets?
options: It is required syntax for Test-DbaDiskSpace to function
It turns several separate command outputs into one structured, per-server record ready to email, export, or dashboard
It automatically fixes any problems it finds
It makes the individual cmdlets run faster
questions.explain: The cmdlets themselves already exist and work individually — the win is combining their results into one coherent report object.

questions.q: Why does the lesson filter Test-DbaDiskSpace results to only drives under 15% free, rather than reporting all drives?
options: Test-DbaDiskSpace cannot return more than one drive at a time
Filtering is required or the cmdlet throws an error
Filtering turns raw data into an actual signal — a report should flag problems, not just list every value
It has no real purpose, just personal preference
questions.explain: The lesson's core principle: filtering to only problem conditions is what makes an automated report worth acting on rather than skimming and ignoring.

questions.q: Why does the lesson recommend only sending an email when $problems is non-empty, rather than sending the full report every time?
options: SQL Server blocks emails containing HTML
A report nobody reads unless something's wrong is more sustainable than one skimmed daily and eventually ignored
Send-MailMessage cannot be used more than once per day
It reduces the size of the database backup
questions.explain: Surfacing problems only when they exist keeps the alert meaningful instead of becoming daily noise that gets tuned out.
